whenToUse: A PIM product editor: bilingual copy, gallery with alt-text checks, variants and channel prices.
Merchandisers checking completeness before publishing to sales channels.
avoidWhen: Editing prices and stock for many products at once — use list-10.
A shopper-facing product page — use product-01.
a11y: Gallery reordering has keyboard handling; image buttons carry aria-labels.
Treat the alt-text check as a requirement — every product image needs meaningful alt text.
